title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Spear Cretin Fiend Spell Ruler SRL-087 Unlimited Common Yugioh
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a must-have for any collector or player. The Spear Cretin card, with an attack power of 500 and defense/toughness of 500, is a common/short print card from the Spell Ruler set. It is an effect type card with the card number SRL-087 and is manufactured by Konami. The card is in English language and is suitable for ages 16+. 

One of the key features of this card is that it is unlimited, which means that it can be played multiple times in a game without worrying about running out of cards. This card is perfect for anyone who wants to add to their collection or improve their gameplay strategy. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and highly sought-after card!
